name: MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_bot_iff
script:
have h_main : ∃ (α : Type u_1) (s : Set α), MeasurableSet s ∧ (s ≠ ∅ ∧ s ≠ Set.univ) := by
  -- We choose a specific type and set to demonstrate the counterexample.
  use ℝ, {x : ℝ | x = 0}
  constructor
  · -- Prove that the set is measurable.
    exact measurableSet_Iio.trans (by simp [Set.Iio_eq_Ioi])
  · -- Prove that the set is neither empty nor the entire space.
    constructor
    · -- Prove that the set is not empty.
      intro h
      have h₁ : (0 : ℝ) ∈ ({x : ℝ | x = 0} : Set ℝ) := by simp
      rw [h] at h₁
      exact Set.not_mem_empty _ h₁
    · -- Prove that the set is not the entire space.
      intro h
      have h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∉ ({x : ℝ | x = 0} : Set ℝ) := by simp
      rw [h] at h₁
      exact h₁ (by norm_num)

-- Use the main result to derive a contradiction.
rcases h_main with ⟨α, s, hs, hne⟩
intro h
have h₁ := h
specialize h₁
simp_all
